描述_EN: the term cizhou encapsulates a range of wares made in several regions of northern china, often consisting of a stoneware body decorated with a bold design. the effect is a crisp and bold design in striking colours. the outlines of this bold geometric design have been carved into the body to avoid the spread of the glazes during firing. this vase is an example of cizhou ware, a type of ceramic made in the northern part of china during the jin dynasty (1115-1234). the stoneware body of this vase has been glazed in a modified version of the sancai three-colour scheme of the tang dynasty, known as song sancai.
描述_ZN: 术语 "Cizhou "概括了中国北方几个地区制造的一系列器物，通常由一个石器主体装饰着大胆的设计。 效果是一个清晰而大胆的设计，颜色醒目。 这个大胆的几何图案的轮廓已经被刻在瓶身上，以避免在烧制过程中釉料的扩散。 这个花瓶是Cizhou ware的一个例子，Cizhou ware是中国北方地区在金朝（1115-1234）时期制造的一种陶瓷类型。 这只花瓶的瓷器主体上了唐代三彩计划的改进版，即宋三彩。
